items.name: spec_compliance
items.note: Right sidebar Info/Folders/Viewer with Environment, Context (tokens+model, no percentage), Outputs (Show more), FolderTree/SmartViewer reuse, compact Info tab; operator decision applied: no poll timer, manual Refresh.

items.name: error_handling
items.note: Explicit loading, error (non-blocking, Refresh recovers), no-session (missing) states; Remote Control pill falls back to Unknown; localStorage reads defensive.

items.name: security_basics
items.note: Read-only; paths rendered as React text; outputs relativized against the PROJECT root, traversal/dot segments rejected client side, files open only via the existing path-guarded file route; unassigned tasks get Info only.

items.name: test_quality
items.note: Unit: format/traversal, sidebar states, no-timer, unassigned, hidden-panel no-scan, layout restore; server type drift guard; E2E real browser incl. layout at 1024/1280/1440/1920, colour legibility, phone tab.

items.name: performance_basics
items.note: No timer; 30 s staleTime for mount/focus; hidden compact panel and collapsed sidebar issue no request; Home/End/keyboard resize cheap.

items.name: naming_structure
items.note: New files under components/external/mission, hooks, lib, styles/mission-sidebar.css; MissionBody.tsx stays under 300 lines; mc-side added to on-photo reset lists.

items.name: affected_boundaries
items.note: Serialized boundary = session-info wire shape; verbatim client mirror + server drift guard session-info-types-sync.test.ts both directions; E2E fulfils the real shape.
